text_block_list.text:
On our way back to the academy after a
day out,
El Condor Pasa stops as though
she's just
remembered something.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
By the way, my favorite female wrestler
has a
match coming up!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She may be young, but she's got real
potential to
be a world champion!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've been cheerin' her on ever since she
made her
debut!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Her name is Ellie Condra! It's kinda
similar to my
name, right?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Why don't we go cheer her on together,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's hard not to be interested after
hearing El
Condor Pasa talk about her
favorite wrestler.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hurra! I can't wait!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: The day of the match...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Vamos, Ellie Condra! You've got this!
Get 'em!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A fierce competition unfolds in front of a
large
and rowdy crowd. And the winner
is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I won! I'm one step closer to world
champion! I'm
gonna prove to everyone
that I'm the world's
strongest!
text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra

text_block_list.text: Whew! That was intense! And what she said at the end!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've got chills! Her strength! Her bravery!
Her
fighting spirit!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You can't help but respect her! Don't
you agree?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: It really was a great match!

text_block_list.text:
Right?! Let's take our time and go over
the match
wh—
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Oh! Th-that's... There she is!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Um... Ellie Condra!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Do I know you?
text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra

text_block_list.text:
I just watched your match! I'm such a big
fan!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you! I'm honored! You're an

Umamusume, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra

text_block_list.text:
Sí! And... my dream is to be the world's
strongest
too!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So... how about it? Let's see who can
become the
world's strongest first!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Me on the track, or you in the ring?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Bursting with excitement, El Condor
Pasa
challenges Ellie Condra, who
responds without
missing a beat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A race to become world champion, huh?
All right,
you're on! But spoiler alert...
text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna beat you there!
text_block_list.name: Ellie Condra

text_block_list.text:
No way, I won't lose! I'm definitely
gonna get
there first!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Sigh... That was like a dream come true. I can't believe I met Ellie Condra!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: And now you've got to beat her!

text_block_list.text:
That's right! Our stages may be
different, but
we're both aiming to be
the world's strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: That means Ellie Condra is now my rival!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса's eyes blaze with fighting
spirit. In
order to feed that flame, we
should...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Can we?! Let's get yakiniku!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I heard Ellie Condra eats several
kilograms of
meat every day!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I can't lose to her in meat either! Let's
eat up and
build stamina!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Now there's an idea! Let's have a little

competition!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Think you can keep up? I'm not gonna
go easy on
ya!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса starts running. There's no
way I
can keep up with her on foot,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Argh! I'll prove to everyone I'm the
world's
strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I can hardly say no with her grinning like
that, so I
end up treating her to several
kilograms of
yakiniku.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
An incredible match and a wonderful
chance
meeting made this a day that I'll
never forget.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
